original: Ranged target refers to a living target being attacked by means of missile combat. When you manage to hit a ranged target - mistakenly or as intended - the target's size, its actions and the final hit accuracy may further modify the true result of the shot/throw. In practice, even a steady shot/throw rarely lands exactly at the center of your aiming point but often deviates somewhat. How off-target your missile is when it arrives at the location of impact determines the final hit accuracy. Depending on the final hit accuracy the actual missile strike may vary from a mere scratch to an impact of full force - or in some cases, it could also be a narrow miss. The smaller the target, the more accurate shot/throw you need to actually hit it. For man-sized targets even the poorest final accuracy always results to a strike of some degree, but anything smaller needs that much more precision. If the final hit accuracy isn't good enough compared to target size the missile won't hit at all. A target that is being attacked by a missile weapon can't choose any conscious defense maneuver as in melee combat, but moving targets can still avoid getting hit. This defense possibility for moving targets is automated and it doesn't matter if the target is aware of the attack or not. A target is considered moving if it is actively running, flying, escaping etc. from one location to another, but also when it's making fast movements in its place like when engaged in a fight. The faster the target is moving the better chance it has to make it out of the way or to make a lucky movement in its place and unintentionally dodge the missile. This is based on the target's actual mobility and manner of moving, so if the target is slowed down due to physical penalties or for whatever reason, its chances to avoid missile attacks are lowered accordingly. Naturally, it's not only the target's speed that matters but the missile velocity as well. It's easier for any moving target to make it out of the way of low-velocity missiles, but very fast animals will be challenging to hit even with bow and arrow - and exceedingly challenging if they are both fast and small.
translation: 远程目标是指遭受投射物攻击的活体目标。当你击中远程目标时——无论是误打误撞还是有意为之——目标的体型、行动以及最终命中精度都会进一步影响射击或投掷的实际结果。实际上，即使瞄准稳定，箭矢或投掷物也很少正好落在瞄准点中心，往往会有所偏移。投射物抵达命中位置时偏离目标中心的程度，决定了最终命中精度。根据最终命中精度，实际打击可能只是擦伤，也可能全力命中；有时甚至会差之毫厘而未命中。目标越小，真正击中它所需的射击或投掷精度就越高。对于人形大小的目标，即使最终精度很差，也总能造成某种程度的打击；体型更小的目标则需要高得多的精度。如果最终命中精度不足以匹配目标大小，投射物就完全打不中。遭受投射武器攻击的目标无法像近战中那样主动选择防御动作，但移动中的目标仍可能躲开。针对移动目标的这种防御会自动判定，无论目标是否察觉到攻击都一样。目标正在主动奔跑、飞行、逃跑等，从一处移动到另一处时，就算处于移动状态；即使留在原地，像战斗中那样快速动作也算。目标移动得越快，就越有可能躲开，或在原地碰巧做出动作而无意中避开投射物。判定取决于目标实际的机动能力和移动方式；如果目标因身体惩罚或其他原因而减速，躲避投射攻击的机会也会相应降低。当然，影响结果的不只是目标速度，投射物的速度也很重要。移动目标更容易躲开低速投射物；即使使用弓箭，速度极快的动物也很难命中，而又快又小的动物更是难上加难。

original: Your character needs to eat and drink regularly to stay alive. There are meters for both hunger and thirst showing your current level. The bars of both meters change their color depending on the long-term level of hunger or thirst - starting at green and gradually turning red when a level of alarming malnutrition or dehydration is reached. Without water you will die in couple of days, so remember to stay close enough to water or carry water with you. Without food you can survive up to a month, but poor diet and insufficient nutrition intake eventually leads to starvation. Eating isn't just about filling your stomach. In order to keep yourself properly fed you shouldn't rely only on hunger cues as your character's feeling of hunger is based not only on stomach content, but also on your body's energy reserves. It's possible to satiate hunger by filling one's stomach with even the poorest food but that doesn't mean your diet contains sufficient amounts of energy or meets your character's nutritional requirements. Even though equal amounts of nearly any food will fill your stomach equally, different kinds of food will give you different levels of nourishment. Nutritional value of the food eaten affects your energy intake and the body's energy reserves. These factors determine how long you will feel satiated and have enough energy in your system. It is possible to increase your character's energy reserve beyond daily needs by constantly eating food with high energy content. After practicing this kind of diet you'll find yourself not being too hungry the day after. When eating a light diet or at times of scarcity you'll notice that you need to eat more often as food with low nutrition and energy content doesn't keep you satiated very long. For the information about your character's nutritional status and body energy reserve you should refer to nutrition dialog box which tells you whether your nutritional condition is starving, malnourished or scarce - good, well-fed or abundant - or something in between.
translation: 角色需要定期进食和饮水才能存活。饥饿和口渴各有一个计量条，显示当前状况。计量条颜色会根据长期饥饿或口渴程度改变：起初为绿色，达到令人担忧的营养不良或脱水程度时会逐渐变红。没有水的话，几天内就会死亡，因此记得待在水源附近，或随身携带饮水。没有食物最多能撑一个月，但饮食不佳、摄入营养不足最终会导致饿死。进食不只是填饱肚子。要保持营养充足，不能只依赖饥饿感，因为角色的饥饿感不仅取决于胃里的食物，也取决于身体的能量储备。即使是最差的食物也能填满胃、缓解饥饿，但这并不意味着饮食提供了足够能量或满足角色的营养需求。几乎任何食物吃下相同分量都会同样填饱肚子，但不同食物提供的营养程度各不相同。所吃食物的营养价值会影响能量摄入和身体能量储备，这些因素决定你能维持饱腹感多久，以及体内能量是否充足。持续食用高能量食物，可以让角色的能量储备超过日常所需。保持这种饮食一段时间后，第二天就不会那么容易饿。饮食清淡或食物短缺时，你会发现自己需要更频繁地进食，因为营养和能量较低的食物无法让你长时间保持饱腹。要了解角色的营养状况和身体能量储备，请查看营养对话框；其中会说明营养状况是饥饿、营养不良或匮乏，是良好、营养充足或充裕，还是介于两者之间。

original:
Shields can be used to block enemy strikes and to protect yourself against missile attacks. In melee combat, merely having a shield wielded allows you to use it for blocking when a defense maneuver is to be chosen. To cover yourself against missile attacks, you need to be holding the shield in protective position. Shields can be held in many ways to cover different body parts and to protect from varying lines of missile attacks. It also depends on the shield size how much of your body it can cover. When a shield is held in protective position missile attacks to covered body parts are automatically blocked as they hit the shield instead of you. You get to choose how to hold a shield upon wielding it. The chosen mode can be changed anytime by attack commands keys [1] or [2] - depending on in which hand you're holding the shield. These are the possible shield modes: CENTER - Neutral position where the shield is held in front of you close to your center. In this position roundshields protect from neck to knees. HIGH - The shield is held up in front of you. In this position roundshields protect the head and upper body. It's a good way to cover the vital upper body, but your vision is restricted as you have to peek from behind the shield. SIDE - The shield is held raised by your side. In this position roundshields protect your side from shoulder to knees. If the shield is your primary weapon it's held on your right side, otherwise on the left side.

All of these shield modes make you walk and run slower as the chosen protective grip and stance is carefully maintained during movements. For this reason it's advisable to use protective shield mode only when necessary.

NONE - Shield is carried in relaxed fashion and not held in protective way. As the shield moves freely along with your movements there's no automatic cover provided except for the hand and arm holding the shield.
translation:
盾牌可以用来格挡敌人的打击，也能保护自己免受投射攻击。近战中，只要手持盾牌，在选择防御动作时就可以用它格挡。要防御投射攻击，则必须将盾牌举在防护位置。盾牌可以用多种方式持握，以遮挡不同身体部位并防御来自不同方向的投射攻击。盾牌能遮挡多少身体部位也取决于其尺寸。盾牌处于防护位置时，攻击被遮挡部位的投射物会自动被盾牌挡下，而不会击中你。装备盾牌时，你可以选择持盾方式。之后可随时按攻击指令键 [1] 或 [2] 更改模式，具体取决于盾牌拿在哪只手。盾牌模式如下： CENTER - 中立位置，盾牌举在身前靠近身体中央处。在此位置，圆盾可保护从颈部到膝盖的部位。 HIGH - 盾牌举高在身前。在此位置，圆盾可保护头部和上半身。这种方式适合遮护重要的上半身部位，但你必须从盾牌后方探看，因此视野会受限。 SIDE - 盾牌举在身体一侧。在此位置，圆盾可保护从肩部到膝盖的侧身。如果盾牌是你的主手武器，则举在右侧；否则举在左侧。

所有这些盾牌模式都会让你走路和奔跑变慢，因为移动时必须谨慎维持防护握姿和站姿。因此，建议只在必要时使用防护持盾模式。

NONE - 放松地携带盾牌，不采取防护姿势。盾牌会随着你的动作自由摆动，除了持盾的手臂外，不会自动提供任何遮挡。

original:
Fishing is a significant source of livelihood and commonly practised by all the cultures of the UnReal World.

There are two kinds of fishing methods, active and passive. Active fishing means using a fishing rod, lippo or certain weapons to catch a fish. Passive fishing is practised with nets.

The idea of fishing with weapons is to stand by the shore waiting for a passing fish and try to spear or club it. This fishing method is fruitful only with relatively big fish and most often the catch is a pike - especially during their spawning period. It's possible to try fishing with any spear or club this way, but tridents are specifically designed for it.

Nets can be used only in deep water. They are set and left in place for a day or two, and then retrieved - hopefully with some fish caught in. To get out into deeper water for setting and retrieving nets a punt or raft is often needed.
The fish to be caught depends on the fishing method, equipment and the fishing site. Different kind of fish live in shallow or deep waters, lakes or rivers. Perches, roaches, breams and pikes are the most common fish living in lakes. Salmons are found mostly in rivers, and especially in rapids during their spawning season. There are also lavarets, trouts, pike-perches and so on.

Fishing is started either by using the fishing skill and choosing the preferred method, or by applying fishing rod or net from the inventory. During the wintertime when the lakes are frozen you need to a make hole in the ice first. That is also done by using your fishing skill.
translation:
钓鱼是虚幻世界各地文化重要且普遍的生计来源。

钓鱼有主动和被动两种方式。主动钓鱼是使用鱼竿、捞鱼网（lippo）或某些武器捕鱼；被动钓鱼则使用渔网。

用武器捕鱼时，要站在岸边等待鱼经过，再尝试用矛刺或用棍棒击打。此法只对较大的鱼有效，最常捕到的是狗鱼，尤其是在它们的产卵期。可以用任何长矛或棍棒尝试这种钓法，但三叉鱼叉是专为此用途设计的。

渔网只能在深水中使用。放好后留在原处一两天，再收回来——希望里面已经捕到鱼。要乘船或木筏到深水区放网和收网，通常需要平底船或木筏。
能捕到什么鱼，取决于钓鱼方式、装备和地点。不同种类的鱼生活在浅水或深水、湖泊或河流中。湖里最常见的是鲈鱼、拟鲤、鲷鱼和狗鱼。鲑鱼主要生活在河流中，产卵季尤其常见于急流处。此外还有白鲑、鳟鱼、梭鲈等。

可以使用钓鱼技能并选择偏好的方法开始钓鱼，也可以从物品栏中使用鱼竿或渔网。冬天湖面结冰时，必须先在冰上凿洞。这也需要使用钓鱼技能。

original:
Sacrifices are a way to thank, to worship or to reward the many otherworldly beings. They are most commonly practiced to keep the nature spirits pleased. Sometimes a sacrifice can also be made in memory of the dead.
Every character knows how to perform a general sacrifice. When combined with detailed instructions of other known spells, the general sacrifice becomes more specialized, offering to a named spirit for a specific purpose.

The sacrifices to the spirits are usually taken to various points in the wilderness or the countryside, to trees and rocks for example. It is most commonly meat or fish that is offered, but some sacrifices can be also cookings such as porridge or bread. On rarer cases shards of silver valuables can also be offered, usually as a part of performing designated spells.

A common example of a situation where a sacrifice is considered necessary is right after killing a significiant game animal, or getting a good catch of fish. The custom is to sacrifice a portion of the very catch to thank the spirits for what they have given you, thus ensuring your future luck with catching the said species.
There are numerous other occasions where a sacrifice can be worthwhile. It is advisable to pay attention to omens and signs you consider meaningful, as they might give a hint if a sacrifice is needed. Also, as you'll learn more spells they sometimes comes with information on how and when to use them for a purposeful sacrifice.
translation:
献祭是向众多异界存在表达感谢、敬奉或酬谢的一种方式。最常见的目的是取悦自然精灵。有时也会为了纪念逝者而献祭。
每个角色都会进行一般献祭。若结合其他已知法术的详细指示，一般献祭便会变成更具针对性的仪式：向某个具名精灵献上祭品，以达成特定目的。

献给精灵的祭品通常会带到荒野或乡间的各类地点，例如树木和岩石处。祭品最常是肉或鱼，有时也会献上粥或面包等熟食。偶尔也会献上银制贵重物品的碎片，通常作为执行指定法术的一部分。

一个常见的献祭场合是猎杀重要猎物，或捕到一大批鱼之后。习俗是拿一部分猎获献给精灵，以感谢它们赐予的收获，并祈求今后还能顺利捕获该物种。
还有许多其他时候献祭也会有所助益。留意你认为有意义的预兆和迹象，它们或许暗示你需要献祭。随着你学会更多法术，其中有时也会说明如何以及何时进行有目的的献祭。

original:
The most well-known spirits are those of the dead and the ruler and guardian spirits of nature. Although everyone can have an occasional direct contact with the spiritworld, there often is a need for the special knowledge of a gifted person who acts as a negotiatior between humans and the spirits.

Northern peoples have shamans as negotiators between the humans and the spiritworld. Among eastern and western peoples the equivalent of shaman is a tietäjä. But there are some differences in techniques used by shamans and tietäjät. A shaman masters a special drumming technique, and a tietäjä is familiar with techniques of verbal exctacy and rune singing. The social role of a shaman or a tietäjä is a very demanding one, for they are responsible for the welfare of the entire community. The position is often handed down from an old master to an apprentice, but there are also some self-thaught healers who become a shaman or a tietäjä when the local people regularly come to seek their servives.

The basic relation between the humans and the spirits is that humans should respect the spirits and not to anger them. Ultimately the spirits can affect every aspect of human life, like ailments and healing, starvation and the luck with hunting and fishing. So, always when someone is healthy and well-fed, one should be thankful for the generous gifts of the spirits. This relation is maintained by the various spells, sacrifices and and magic means.
translation:
最为人熟知的精灵包括逝者的灵魂，以及自然的统治者和守护精灵。虽然每个人偶尔都可能直接接触灵界，但人与精灵沟通时往往需要有天赋者掌握特殊知识，担当中介。

北方民族由萨满担任人类与灵界之间的中介。东方和西方民族中与萨满相当的是 tietäjä（知者）。不过萨满和 tietäjä 使用的技法有所不同：萨满精通特殊的击鼓技法，tietäjä 则熟悉言语入神和吟唱符文。萨满或 tietäjä 承担的社会职责要求很高，因为他们要对整个群体的福祉负责。这个身份通常由年长的师傅传给学徒，但也有一些自学成才的治疗者；当地人定期向他们求助后，他们也会成为萨满或 tietäjä。

人与精灵之间的基本关系是尊重精灵，不要激怒它们。归根结底，精灵能影响人类生活的方方面面，例如疾病与疗愈、饥荒，以及狩猎和捕鱼的运气。因此，只要身体健康、食物充足，就应感谢精灵慷慨赐予的一切。人们通过各种法术、献祭和魔法手段维系这种关系。

original:
Lippo is a kind of a dip net used for catching fish from rapids and shallow waters. Fishing with a lippo is especially effective only at certain times of the year; when the fish to be caught are migrating upstream to their spawning locations, and during the active spawning period. Thus, the most common fish that are caught with the lippo, are the migratory salmon and lavaret.

A Lippo is constructed in such a way that it has a wooden hoop into which multiple small birch saplings are tied to. These saplings are tied together at their open ends, so that they form a net like construction around the hoop. The hoop with a net is then fixed to a long wooden pole.

Fishing with a lippo in the rivers and rapids is done by standing on rocks in the river. The location is often suitable when there are several rocks around as these are the usual places where both resting and spawning river fish are around and can be caught.
The lippo is lowered into the water, down to the bottom, and carefully dragged around in order to catch resting or spawning fish into its hoop. Successful lippo fishing is greatly based on knowledge of the locations where the fish might dwell. Start using your lippo either by using the fishing skill or by applying the lippo from the inventory.

Additionally, a lippo can also be used from the shore to catch spawning pikes or breams.
translation:
Lippo 是一种捞鱼网，用来在急流和浅水中捕鱼。只有在一年中的特定时节，使用 lippo 才特别有效：目标鱼类正洄游至上游产卵地时，以及产卵活动期间。因此，用 lippo 最常捕到的是洄游的鲑鱼和白鲑。

Lippo 的结构是把多个细小的桦树苗绑在木圈上，再将这些树苗的开口端扎在一起，使其围绕木圈形成网状结构。随后把带网的木圈固定在一根长木杆上。

在河流和急流中使用 lippo 捕鱼时，要站在河里的岩石上。周围有多块岩石的地方往往适合捕鱼，因为河鱼通常会在这些地方休息或产卵，也较容易捕到。
将 lippo 放入水中沉至河底，再小心地四处拖动，把休息或产卵的鱼捞进网圈。成功使用 lippo 很大程度上取决于是否了解鱼可能栖息的地点。可以使用钓鱼技能开始操作，也可以从物品栏中使用 lippo。

此外，也可以站在岸边使用 lippo，捞捕正在产卵的狗鱼或鲷鱼。

original: The ability to move silently and without being detected. Stealth-skill is checked every time your character advances while sneaking. You can start sneaking by using [h]ide command. It should be understood that sneaking doesn't make you invisible. Foremost, stealth is a skill that helps to decrease the noise you make while advancing. To some degree stealth-skill also determines your character's ability to use available cover to avoid being seen directly. If you sneak in front of someone in the open, they probably can see you as well as you can see them. Therefore it's always best practice to sneak upon your target from behind, and along a path that provides reasonable cover. Stealth-skill is also subject to physical penalties for it's more difficult to move silently if you are injured or carrying heavy loads. There are also additional factors which may interfere with the success of sneaking upon on your target. Distance to target, available cover and the acuity of the observers senses all affect to how easy, or difficult, somebody is to detect. Many animals have superior hearing and sense of smell and therefore sneaking on animals can sometimes result in getting just a few steps closer to your prey before it spots you. But often closing the distance even a little can be a crucial advantage in hunting.
translation: 潜行是安静移动而不被察觉的能力。角色每次潜行前进时，都会检定潜行技能。使用 [h]ide 指令即可开始潜行。需要明白，潜行并不会让你隐形。首先，潜行技能能降低你移动时发出的声响；在一定程度上，它也决定角色能否利用现有掩护避免被直接看见。如果你在空旷处从某人面前潜行而过，对方很可能也能像你看见他一样看见你。因此，最好从目标背后接近，并选择有适当掩护的路线。受伤或负重很重时，想要安静移动会更困难，所以潜行技能也会受到身体惩罚的影响。还有其他因素会影响接近目标时潜行是否成功。与目标的距离、可用掩护，以及观察者感官的敏锐程度，都会影响一个人有多容易被发现。许多动物的听觉和嗅觉都很出色，因此潜行接近动物时，有时只能比它发现你之前多走几步。不过，哪怕只缩短一点距离，也常能在狩猎时带来关键优势。

original: To obtain some soil for his own agricultural purposes, man has to cut down some forest. The easiest and most effective way is to burn all the trees which are cut down. Yet it is heavy work, as all the tree-stumps have to be taken up before burning. While burning man has to be careful not to let the fire get loose. But after succesful burning man has turned an area of forest into a soil for agriculture. Typically the freshly burnt area is used to grow turnips for one or two years. After that the area is used to grow broad beans or rye or barley. After those the area is still good enough for flax to grow. But after that the area is pretty much exhausted, and is left for animals to graze. By years the area will turn into a nice meadow, slowly growing some willow, and later some birch, and after twenty or thirty years the same area is ready to be burnt again. With that kind of a cycle a family can every year burn down a new area near their home. But if the slash-and-burn cultivation is very extensive, farmers will have to go farther away from their homes to find enough suitable areas for burning. Eventually a family might even pack their stuff and move deeper into the wilderness, build a new house and have a fresh start every thirty years or so.
translation: 为了获得可供耕种的土地，人们必须砍伐森林。最简单、最有效的方法是将砍下的树木全部烧掉。不过这是一项繁重的工作，因为焚烧前必须先把所有树桩挖出来。焚烧时也必须小心，避免火势失控。若焚烧顺利，森林地便会变成农田。通常新烧出的土地会种一两年萝卜，之后种蚕豆、黑麦或大麦。再往后，这块地仍适合种亚麻。但此后土地基本耗尽，就会留作动物放牧。经年累月，这片地会变成美丽的草甸，先慢慢长出一些柳树，之后再长出桦树。二三十年后，同一片土地便可以再次焚烧。遵循这样的循环，一个家庭每年都能在住处附近烧出一片新地。但如果广泛采用刀耕火种，农民就得走得更远，寻找足够适合焚烧的土地。最终，一个家庭甚至可能收拾行装，迁入更深的荒野，建造新居，并大约每三十年重新开始一次。

original: Cookery is the ability to prepare and preserve food. The simplest cooking methods, such as boiling and roasting, are often used when preparing food in the wild and can be used for practically any kind of raw food: meat, fish or a wide variety of plants. More complicated recipes use more advanced cooking techniques, a larger range of ingredients and more cooking implements, though they also produce a much larger variety of food. Some source of heat is almost always required. A knife, a pot, bowl or cup are the most basic cooking utensils. Different plants have different effects. Some may be poisonous, have medicinal values or other effects. For this reason, plants (especially mushrooms) are often boiled first before use, and this is the method most commonly used to create herbal beverages. In addition to cooking food for immediate consumption, cookery also covers three basic preservation methods, which are drying, smoking and salting. These are used when large quantities of meat or fish are obtained and must be preserved for later use. Depending on the method used the meat will last for different lengths of time. Preserved food can stay edible for weeks or even months, extremely useful in times of scarcity, such as the harsh winter.
translation: 烹饪技能是准备和保存食物的能力。最简单的烹饪方式，如煮和烤，在野外经常使用，几乎适用于任何生食：肉、鱼或各种植物。更复杂的食谱需要更先进的烹饪技法、更多种类的食材和更多烹饪器具，但也能制作出种类丰富得多的食物。烹饪几乎总是需要热源。刀、锅、碗或杯是最基本的烹饪用具。不同植物的效果各不相同，有些可能有毒，有些具有药用价值或其他作用。因此，植物（尤其是蘑菇）通常会先煮熟再使用；制作草药饮品时也最常采用这种方法。除了烹制即时食用的食物，烹饪技能还包括三种基本保存方法：风干、熏制和腌制。大量捕获肉类或鱼类后，需要用这些方法保存起来以备日后食用。不同方法能让肉类保存不同时间。保存后的食物可食用数周甚至数月，在严冬等食物匮乏时期尤其有用。

original: Dodge refers to one of your characters's skills, and is also one of the defense maneuvers. As a skill, it determines your ability to dodge melee attacks. The initial level of dodging skill is based on your character's agility, but like any other skill, it can be improved by experience. As a defense maneuver, dodging is an attempt to evade attacks by ducking, leaping, or otherwise trying to get out of harm's way. Dodging is always a demanding feat of agility, and can result in stumbling or falling if performed clumsily. At its very best, a swift and graceful dodge not only saves the defender from getting struck, but may also grant him/her a tactical advantage. When an attempt to dodge is only partially succesful, the defender gets struck, but the force of the attack is decreased accordingly. Dodging is most effective against weapons with a short reach - this also covers unarmed attacks. When trying to dodge weapons with a good reach and high attack class dodging gets that much more challenging. Dodge is an applicable defense maneuver only against melee attacks. When being attacked by means of missile combat, the factors determining the defender's chances to avoid the attack are calculated differenty.
translation: 闪避既是角色的一项技能，也是防御动作之一。作为技能，它决定你躲避近战攻击的能力。角色初始闪避技能等级取决于敏捷，但和其他技能一样，可以通过经验提升。作为防御动作，闪避是尝试通过弯腰、跳跃或其他方式避开攻击、脱离危险。闪避始终非常考验敏捷；动作笨拙时可能绊倒或摔倒。若发挥得当，迅捷优雅的闪避不但能让防御者免受打击，还可能带来战术优势。若闪避只取得部分成功，防御者仍会被击中，但攻击力度会相应减弱。闪避对攻击距离较短的武器最有效，也包括徒手攻击。面对攻击距离较长、攻击类型较高的武器时，闪避会困难得多。闪避只能用于防御近战攻击。遭受投射攻击时，决定防御者能否躲开的因素会以不同方式计算。

original: Guardian spirits and supernatural dwellers are special spirits and beings taking care of their own area. These spirits dwell in the forests, in the buildings, in the lakes and so on. The guardian spirit of the forest is one of the strongest spirits, and has many more lesser helpers. He looks after animals, trees, plants and even stones. So when in the forest you should be constantly aware of all the signs and marks which can tell you whether the guardian of the forest is pleased or not. The lake dweller is also a powerful spirit. The underwater spirits are very highly respected. They do not only take care of fish, they can also send storms, water monsters, or the most powerful creatures ever seen in the world. Whatever you do you should keep the spirits on your mind. For example, if you happen to find an empty cottage in the forest, you should (if you know how to) ask the spirits for a permission to sleep there. Or when you get a great catch of fish or a prey you should thank the proper guardian spirits for that. When you keep the guardians pleased they will look after you and help you. If you anger the spirits they may revenge or make your living on their area difficult.
translation: 守护精灵和超自然居住者是守护各自区域的特殊精灵与存在。它们居住在森林、建筑、湖泊等地方。森林守护精灵是最强大的精灵之一，还有许多较弱的助手。它照看动物、树木、植物，甚至石头。因此身处森林时，应时刻留意各种迹象和痕迹，以判断森林守护者是否满意。湖泊居住者也是强大的精灵。水下精灵备受敬重。它们不但照看鱼类，也能带来风暴、水怪，甚至世上最强大的生物。无论做什么，都应把精灵放在心上。例如，若你在森林里发现一间空屋（若懂得方法），应请求精灵允许你在那里过夜。捕到大批鱼或猎获猎物时，也应感谢相应的守护精灵。取悦守护者，它们便会照看并帮助你；若激怒它们，它们可能报复，或让你在其领地上的生活变得艰难。

original: A defense maneuver where the defender attempts to strike the attacker back - and preferably first - instead of defending themselves from the attack. It is possible to use any of your wielded weapons to counterstrike, but as combat results tend to be bloody and slightly favour the attacker it's wise to choose a weapon you are very skilled with. Nearly always when an attack is answered by a counterstrike one or both of the combatants gets struck. Simultaneous strikes may occur as well. Against an equally or more skilled opponent counterstrikes are always a gamble, but one lucky counterstrike may also turn the tables to the advantage of the underdog. Should the counterstrikes be by far superior to the attacker's strikes, the defender can usually bring the battle to a quick end. For human characters a counterstrike always requires usage of a weapon, but animals can also make counterattacks - and that's what raging or desperate beasts usually choose to do - and very effectively. An angry bear that constantly keeps attacking back at you can be nearly impossible to bring down by one man alone.
translation: 一种防御动作：防御者尝试反击攻击者，而且最好抢先出手，而不是防御对方的攻击。你可以用任何已装备的武器进行反击；但战斗结果往往血腥，且略微偏向攻击者，因此最好选择自己非常擅长的武器。攻击遭到反击时，几乎总会有一方或双方被击中，也可能同时命中。面对技能相当或更强的对手，反击始终是一场赌博；但一次幸运反击也可能让弱势一方扭转局面。如果防御者的反击明显强于攻击者的打击，通常可以迅速结束战斗。人类角色反击时总要使用武器，但动物也会反击——发狂或走投无路的野兽通常会选择这样做，而且效果很好。一头不断反扑的愤怒巨熊，几乎不是一个人能打倒的。

original: The grey seal lives in the sea and can be found on coastal regions of the UnReal World. They are large seals, with males weighing up to 300 kg. Grey seals live together in colonies of varying size and feed on a wide variety of fish. They spend most of their days in the water but do regularly come ashore to rest and pass time in carefully chosen locations. During open water season they prefer to rest on rocky surfaces of the utmost skerries and islets of the sea. In the winter they do live near the edge of the ice, spending the lazy hours on the ice. The grey seal is most the important prey animal for seal-tribe, but also islanders and sartolaiset hunt them. Seals are most commonly and effectively hunted on the ice, relying on stealth or patience - and ango. Islanders and seal-tribe who are familiar with the local seal colonies also hunt them during summer using a bow and arrow to shoot them from the islets and skerries. Seal furs aren't very thick but still nicely warm. Because of their rarity seal furs are more valuable than the furs of most of the commonly sought after land animals.
translation: 灰海豹生活在海中，可在虚幻世界的沿海地区找到。它们体型庞大，雄性体重可达 300 千克。灰海豹群居，群体大小不一，以各种鱼类为食。它们大部分时间都待在水里，但也会定期上岸休息，并在精心挑选的地点消磨时光。无冰季节，它们喜欢在海上最外侧的礁岩和小岛上休息；冬季则生活在冰缘附近，悠闲地躺在冰面上。灰海豹是海豹部族最重要的猎物，但岛民和 sartolaiset 也会捕猎它们。最常见且有效的方式是在冰上依靠潜行或耐心狩猎——也会使用 ango。熟悉当地海豹群的岛民和海豹部族，也会在夏季用弓箭从小岛和礁石上射猎。海豹皮不算很厚，但保暖效果不错。由于较为稀有，海豹皮比大多数常见陆地动物的皮毛更值钱。

original:
Every bow needs to be strung with a proper bowstring before it can be used to shoot arrows.
Bowstrings wear out in use and thus need to be replaced every now and then. The lower the quality, the faster the bowstring is prone to breaking. A good quality bowstring can last up to roughly a thousand shots.
When the bowstring breaks, a message is displayed and the bow gets described as a "bow with no string". You can add a new bowstring to a bow with no string with the [a]pply command. First apply the bowstring, and then select a bow to be strung with the string.
Proper bowstrings are made out of multiple strands of yarn twisted together, but you could also use thin cordage for a makeshift bowstring. Upon crafting a bowstring you can select the material to be used, either yarn or cord. It's faster to make a bowstring from a cord and the required length is also far shorter, but bowstrings made out of cords are also always of lesser quality.
translation:
每张弓都必须装上合适的弓弦才能射箭。
弓弦使用后会磨损，因此需要不时更换。品质越差，弓弦越容易断。优质弓弦大约能承受一千次射击。
弓弦断裂时会显示一条消息，弓也会被描述为“无弦之弓”。可以使用 [a]pply 指令为无弦之弓装上新弓弦。先使用弓弦，然后选择要装弦的弓。
合适的弓弦由多股纱线拧合而成，不过也可以用细绳临时充当弓弦。制作弓弦时，可以选择使用纱线或绳索作为材料。用绳索制作更快，所需长度也短得多，但绳索制成的弓弦品质总是较低。

original:
Salmon is a large and valued migratory fish that can be encountered in rivers and inland lakes, as well as in the sea and coastal areas. As a migratory fish, salmon travels through the rivers.

Salmons hatch in freshwater headstreams and spend their juvenile years in rivers and lakes. Upon maturing, they migrate to the sea, and return back to rivers to spawn. It is said that salmons return to spawn in the very same river that they originated from.

During the salmon migration and spawning they are caught from the rivers and rapids especially well with a lippo. Salmon migrates from the sea up the rivers throughout the summer. They do dwell in the rivers until the spawning starts in late autumn, usually around fall or dirt month. The actual spawning time depends on the water temperature which needs to be fairly cold for the salmons to start their spawning. When the spawning starts, it lasts for a few weeks.
translation:
鲑鱼是一种体型较大、颇受重视的洄游鱼类，可在河流、内陆湖泊、海洋及沿海地区遇到。作为洄游鱼，鲑鱼会沿河迁徙。

鲑鱼在淡水上游河段孵化，幼年时生活在河流和湖泊中。成熟后，它们迁往海洋，之后再返回河流产卵。据说鲑鱼会回到自己出生的那条河产卵。

鲑鱼洄游和产卵期间，使用 lippo 在河流及急流中尤其容易捕获它们。整个夏季，鲑鱼都会从海里沿河上溯。它们会留在河流中，直到晚秋开始产卵，通常在秋月或休耕月左右。产卵的具体时间取决于水温；水温必须相当低，鲑鱼才会开始产卵。产卵期一旦开始，会持续数周。

original:
The local people of The UnReal World dress themselves in a variety of fur, leather, and cloth garments. In addition, there is a selection of woollen garments made using the nalbinding technique, as well as some garments made of birch bark.
The choice of materials for people's clothing depends on their availability and the culture in question, and the same type of clothing can often be made from a wide range of materials, each adding different properties to the finished item.

Clothing names are quite self-explanatory, but here you can find details of some commonly encountered garments:

Head: CAP, COWL, VEIL (women), FUR HOOD

Upper body: SHIRT, UNDERSHIRT, TUNIC (men), UNDERGARMENT (women), DRESS (women), CLOAK

Lower body: LEGGINGS, TROUSERS (men), APRON (women)

Feet: FOOTRAGS, NALBOUND SOCKS, NALBOUND KNEE SOCKS, SHOES, BOOTS

Hands: MITTENS
translation:
虚幻世界的当地居民穿着各式各样的皮毛、皮革和布料衣物。此外，还有用 nalbinding（针毡编结）技法制作的羊毛衣物，以及一些桦树皮制成的衣物。
人们选择何种衣料，取决于材料是否容易获得以及所属文化。同一种衣物往往能用多种材料制作，而每种材料都会赋予成品不同特性。

衣物名称大多一目了然，下面列出一些常见衣物的详情：

头部：CAP、COWL、VEIL（女性）、FUR HOOD

上身：SHIRT、UNDERSHIRT、TUNIC（男性）、UNDERGARMENT（女性）、DRESS（女性）、CLOAK

下身：LEGGINGS、TROUSERS（男性）、APRON（女性）

足部：FOOTRAGS、NALBOUND SOCKS、NALBOUND KNEE SOCKS、SHOES、BOOTS

手部：MITTENS

original:
Clothes can be made of wide variety of materials with variying techniques. Materials used in clothing in the UnReal World can be separated into two groups.
Those originating from the vegetable kingdom are: CLOTH and BIRCH-BARK and those originating from the animal kingdom are: WOOL, LEATHER and FUR


Metal armours are not usually worn nor made among the local cultures of The UnReal World. They are brought in with foreign traders and warriors. In general metal armours are very rare, and even the foreign warriors need to rely mostly on fur and leather for protection. Helms, cowls and pieces for spot protection are far more common than body armours. Wealthy villages of DriikilΣiset, Sartolaiset, Koivulaiset and ReemilΣiset may very rarely have some traded metal armours available. Metal armour materials and techniques are: MAIL, IRON and LAMELLAR
translation:
衣物可以用多种材料和不同技法制作。虚幻世界中的衣料可分为两类。
植物来源的材料有：CLOTH 和 BIRCH-BARK；动物来源的材料有：WOOL、LEATHER 和 FUR。


虚幻世界的当地文化通常不穿戴或制作金属盔甲。金属盔甲由外国商人和战士带来。总体而言，金属盔甲极为罕见，即使外国战士也主要依靠皮毛和皮革防护。头盔、罩帽和局部护具比躯干盔甲常见得多。Driikiläiset、Sartolaiset、Koivulaiset 和 Reemiläiset 的富裕村落中，偶尔才会有一些交易来的金属盔甲。金属盔甲的材料与技法包括：MAIL、IRON 和 LAMELLAR。

original:
Driikiläiset (Those Who Live In The Driik) live on the south-west coastal area. They live in villages and towns, of which some are protected by walls. Driikiläiset are well connected to a network of trading routes. They send their ships abroad, they trade with inland tribes and with the fishermen of the archipelago. From time to time Driikiläiset are attacked by foreign bandits who may sometimes sail from a great distance to attack Driik coast.

Driikiläiset can be considered to be more organized than rest of the peoples of The UnReal World. They have differentiated professions - merchants, hunters, farmers, craftsmen and blacksmiths. In Driik you can find a variety of imported rare weapons such as crossbows and battleaxes, along with pieces of metal armour and foreign swords. Some of their own blacksmiths can also produce swords and helmets.
translation:
Driikiläiset（居住在 Driik 的人）生活在西南沿海地区。他们居住在村庄和城镇中，其中一些有城墙保护。Driikiläiset 与贸易路线网络联系紧密。他们派船出海，和内陆部族以及群岛渔民交易。Driikiläiset 时常遭到外国匪徒袭击；这些人有时会从很远的地方乘船而来，攻击 Driik 海岸。

与虚幻世界的其他民族相比，Driikiläiset 的组织更加完善。他们分工明确，有商人、猎人、农民、工匠和铁匠。在 Driik 可以找到各种进口稀有武器，如弩和战斧，以及金属盔甲部件和外国剑。有些当地铁匠也能制作剑和头盔。

original:
Smoking is the process of preserving meat or fish by exposing it to smoke in a heated room. In unreal world this is cold smoking process and takes a few weeks to complete. The meat or fish smoked this way preserves for a long time.
The smoking requires hanging the meat or fish in the room by cords or other tying equipment, and continous maintaining of fire. It's not critical to maintain an exact temperature but the fireplace in your smoking cabin should be warmed up properly on daily basis. Should you forget it one day it's still possible to compensate by heating it up even more the next day.
If the heating is completely neglected you will find your smoked foodstuff all spoiled. If the heating has failed only to some extent you may find some of the smoked foods spoiled.
The smoking is initiated by using your COOKERY skill.
translation:
熏制是将肉或鱼放在加热的房间里，用烟熏的方式保存食物。在虚幻世界中采用的是冷熏法，完成整个过程需要数周。经过这种方式熏制的肉或鱼可以保存很久。
熏制时需要用绳索或其他捆绑工具将肉或鱼挂在房间里，并持续照看火堆。不必把温度控制得十分精确，但熏制小屋里的炉火需要每天充分加热。如果某天忘了加热，第二天加大火力仍可补救。
如果完全不加热，熏制的食物就会全部腐坏。如果加热只是部分失败，则可能有一些食物变质。
使用 COOKERY 技能即可开始熏制。

original:
The world of the game is strongly based on and inspired by finnish iron age, about 800 - 1000 A.D. The game takes place in The Unreal World, which is an imaginary world based on finnish history and folklore.

The game is completely open-ended and you decide whether you wish to lead a life of a fisherman, a hermit searching for the peace, a brave adventurer, a rough hunter, a trapper or a tradesman. There are infinite ways to play the game, to live off the land and to find excitement in surviving everyday life. You are free to choose your way of life in this very detailed, deep and realistic game world in which northern folklore, knowledge and way of life play an important part.

We use finnish-like words in many names in the game. See LANGUAGE for more information.
translation:
本游戏深受芬兰铁器时代（约公元 800 至 1000 年）的启发，并以此为基础。游戏发生在虚构的虚幻世界中，其背景取材于芬兰历史和民间传说。

本游戏没有固定结局，你可以决定自己想过什么样的生活：做渔夫、寻求安宁的隐士、勇敢的冒险者、粗犷的猎人、设陷阱的捕猎者，或商人。游戏方式无穷无尽，你可以靠土地谋生，在日常求生中寻找乐趣。你可以在这个细节丰富、深邃而真实的游戏世界里自由选择生活方式；北方民间传说、知识和生活方式在其中扮演重要角色。

游戏中的许多名称采用类似芬兰语的词语。更多信息请参见 LANGUAGE。

original:
There are countless stories, legends and myths about The First Winter. During The First Winter The Inehmo became many, men, wifes, children, the heroes and the wise ones walked the earth. The heroes made the fire, they made the bow and the arrow and they hunted. They made clothes, they made tools and shelters, they made skis, and they made drums and the kantele (a kind of a harp).

When The First Winter was over, inehmoes could not understand The Wind singing, nor The Bear and The Forest humming. The wise ones among the people said that The World was no more real. The World was Unreal. Still, inehmoes can return to the Real World in the dreams and with the spells. The Shamans became negotiators between the people and the spiritworld, the otherworld, The Real World.
translation:
关于“第一个冬天”，流传着无数故事、传说和神话。第一个冬天时，Inehmo 变成了许多个体；男人、妻子、孩子、英雄和智者行走于大地。英雄们创造了火，发明了弓箭并狩猎。他们制作衣服、工具和住所，发明了滑雪板，还制作了鼓和一种类似竖琴的乐器——kantele。

第一个冬天结束后，inehmoes 再也听不懂风的歌声，也听不懂熊和森林的低语。人群中的智者说，世界已不再真实。这个世界是虚幻的。然而，inehmoes 仍能在梦境中、借助法术返回真实世界。萨满成为人们与灵界、异界，也就是真实世界之间的中介。

original:
Sky Father and Earth Mother wondered why The Inehmo did not wake up. "Maybe our dear child is waiting for a light", Earth Mother said. So they called all the creatures to gather for The Circle of Life. All the creatures sat in a great circle and they did sing together. As their tune went on, The Stars, The Moon and finally The Sun came in to the existence. The Inehmo woke up and joined The Circle.

The Inehmo understood everything that was sung. The Inehmo could easily communicate with The Animals, with The Stones and The Trees. There was no pain. As The Sun and The Moon walked along their paths, air became cold and harsh wind rose. Soon the earth froze, it was snowing. The Inehmo felt cold, and had to build a lodge.

It was The First Winter.
translation:
天父与地母纳闷 Inehmo 为何还没有醒来。“也许我们亲爱的孩子在等待光明。”地母说道。于是他们召集所有生灵参加生命之环。众生围坐成一个大圆圈，一同歌唱。随着歌声响起，星辰、月亮，最后太阳也诞生了。Inehmo 醒来，加入生命之环。

Inehmo 听得懂歌中的一切，轻易就能与动物、石头和树木交流。那时没有痛苦。太阳和月亮沿着各自的轨迹运行，空气渐渐变冷，刺骨的狂风也刮了起来。不久，大地冻结，天空开始降雪。Inehmo 感到寒冷，只得建造一间小屋。

那就是第一个冬天。

original:
The dead of the northern people live in an otherworld which is very far away in the north, behind the black river of the death. It usually is the duty of the shaman to negotiate with the dead ones.

The dead of the eastern and western people live in the otherworlds near the villages. The living relatives can and should communicate with the late ones. If the dead feel that they are not respected, they are eager to cause harm, such as diseases and madness. Almost anyone can consult his or her late relatives to ask help, for example. But when there are some more serious problems, such as restless souls of the violently killed people, it is the duty of the tietäjä to restore the normal situation.
translation:
北方民族的逝者居住在遥远北方的异界，那里位于死亡黑河的另一边。通常由萨满负责与逝者沟通。

东方和西方民族的逝者居住在村庄附近的异界。活着的亲属能够、也应该与逝者交流。如果亡者觉得自己没有受到尊重，便可能带来疾病和疯狂等祸害。几乎任何人都可以向已故亲属请教并寻求帮助。但若遇到更严重的问题，例如被暴力杀害者的灵魂不得安宁，就该由 tietäjä 出面恢复秩序。

original:
The bream is a relatively common fish living in the inland lakes and slow flowing rivers. Breams prefer large lakes and tend to move in swarms. They are usually caught using nets, but can also be caught with a common fishing rod.

During their spawning season, breams can also be caught by spear fishing. Much like pikes, breams also spawn at vegetation rich, shallow shoreline waters. Spawning breams are easily spotted in the shallow waters and can be speared or scooped into a lippo from the shore.

Spawning of the bream usually takes place from seedtime to fallow month when the water is suitably warm for the purpose. The spawning happens in cycles that can last for quite a long time.
translation:
鲷鱼是比较常见的鱼类，生活在内陆湖泊和水流缓慢的河流中。它们偏爱大型湖泊，往往成群活动。通常用渔网捕捉，也可以用普通鱼竿钓到。

产卵季也可以用鱼叉捕鲷鱼。和狗鱼一样，鲷鱼也会在植被茂盛的浅岸水域产卵。产卵的鲷鱼在浅水中很容易发现，可以从岸边用鱼叉刺捕，或用 lippo 捞起。

鲷鱼通常在播种月到休耕月之间产卵，此时水温适宜。产卵会分阶段进行，持续时间可能相当长。

original:
Bark of different trees is used as raw material in various crafts, and also as tanning materials in hideworking. Bark can be harvested from rowan, alder, pine and birch trees by using the TIMBERCRAFT skill.
Pine bark can be used in making of floats for fishing nets. It can be harvested in chunks all year round from big pine trees.
From the leaf trees the bark can't be harvested all year round, but the best season for this is early summer. The process gets more difficult and the yield decreases accordingly outside the proper bark harvesting period, and eventually it becomes completely impossible in the late autumn. Birch-bark has the most versatile uses of all the bark types.
translation:
不同树木的树皮可用作各种手工艺的原料，也可在皮革加工中用作鞣制材料。使用 TIMBERCRAFT 技能，可以从花楸、桤木、松树和桦树上采集树皮。
松树皮可用于制作渔网浮子；全年都可以从大松树上采下整块树皮。
阔叶树的树皮无法全年采集，最佳时节是初夏。错过适宜的采集期后，采集过程会更加困难，收获也会减少；到了深秋就完全无法采集。桦树皮的用途最为广泛。

original: The arctic fox is slightly smaller than the ordinary fox. The fur is graywhite in the winter and dark grayish brown in the summer. Despite of the smaller size arctic fox furs quite a bit more valuable than ordinary fox furs. Arctic foxes are most common in the north, but can occasionally wander everywhere else in the unreal world too. In addition to wandering in coniferous forests and mires they can also thrive in rough terrain such as barren heaths, cliffs and fjells. Whereas ordinary foxes are most active in the dusk and at night, arctic foxes are active all day around. Arctic foxes are also more curious and less intimidated by humans than ordinary foxes.
translation: 北极狐比普通狐狸略小。它的皮毛冬季呈灰白色，夏季则为深灰棕色。尽管体型较小，北极狐皮却比普通狐皮值钱得多。北极狐最常见于北方，但偶尔也会游荡到虚幻世界的其他地方。它们除了出没于针叶林和沼泽，也能在荒凉的石楠荒地、峭壁和高山等崎岖地形中生存。普通狐狸主要在黄昏和夜间活动，而北极狐则整天都很活跃。北极狐也更好奇，对人类的畏惧感比普通狐狸弱。

original: Njerpezit are of eastern race. Black haired Njerpez men are considered notorious bandits. Njerpez men do attack other people, killing, robbing and raiding. Their typical melee weapons consist of spears, scimitars and roundshields. Chieftains might have helms and lamellar armours, and more rarely mail gear. Njerpez are interested in furs, those of squirrels, bears, wolves, beavers and lynxes. Animal fur is of the very best quality in The Kaumo, and the merchants of the southern domains are willing to pay plenty for the finest northern furs. Njerpezit strive for conquering the hunting-grounds of Kaumolaiset, and this is what they have been doing for decades.
translation: Njerpezit 属于东方民族。黑发的 Njerpez 男子以臭名昭著的匪徒形象闻名。他们会袭击其他人，杀人、劫掠和掠夺。常用的近战武器包括长矛、弯刀和圆盾。酋长可能装备头盔和札甲，更少见的是锁子甲。Njerpezit 对松鼠、熊、狼、河狸和猞猁的皮毛感兴趣。Kaumo 的动物皮毛品质极佳，南方领地的商人愿意为最上等的北方毛皮付出高价。数十年来，Njerpezit 一直企图征服 Kaumolaiset 的猎场。

original: The length of the lynx varies from 70 to 120 cm and weight from 20 to 30 kg. The fur is reddish-gray in the summer and grayish-white in the winter, always with black and brown dots and streaks. The lynx dwells in areas with hills and jagged rocks. It is active in the night and twilight-time, sometimes also in the daytime. Lynxes eat almost everything from small rodents to reindeers. Reindeers and hares are its most common prey. Its hunting method is to sneak close to the prey and then to catch it with one or two leaps before the prey animal gets alarmed. It is not easy to see lynx because it can hear the hunter from a long distance.
translation: 猞猁体长约 70 至 120 厘米，体重约 20 至 30 千克。夏季皮毛呈红灰色，冬季呈灰白色，上面总有黑色和棕色的斑点与条纹。猞猁栖息在有山丘和嶙峋岩石的地区。它们在夜间和黄昏活动，有时白天也会出没。猞猁几乎什么都吃，从小型啮齿动物到驯鹿都是食物。驯鹿和野兔是它们最常捕食的猎物。它们会悄悄接近猎物，然后在猎物察觉之前用一两次跳跃将其扑倒。猞猁听觉敏锐，能从很远处听见猎人，因此不容易被发现。

original: Hunting can be separated into active and passive hunting. Passive hunting means using traps. Active hunting means encountering the animal and killing it down by using hunting weapons, of which various bows and spears are the most commonly used. Animals can be encountered randomly - which is especially the case with the widespread small animals like hares, squirrels and birds. Or one can use his tracking skills to find and follow the tracks of his prey. Sightings of big carnivores - bear, lynx, wolf and glutton - are usually such a news that you'll most likely hear about them if you talk to the people you meet.
translation: 狩猎分为主动和被动两种方式。被动狩猎是使用陷阱；主动狩猎则是遇到动物后用狩猎武器将其杀死，最常用的武器是各种弓和长矛。动物可能会随机出现，尤其是野兔、松鼠和鸟类等分布广泛的小动物。你也可以运用追踪技能寻找并跟随猎物留下的踪迹。大型食肉动物——熊、猞猁、狼和狼獾——的目击消息通常会传开；你和遇到的人交谈时，很可能会听说它们的行踪。

original: Trap-pits are commonly used to hunt big deer such as elks and reindeers. A shovel is needed to dig a pit which can then be covered. This is the most simple form of a trap-pit. It's also possible place sharp wooden stakes at the bottom of the pit, which makes it an improved and more lethal form of a trap-pit. In case of trap-pits, fences are commonly used to guide the prey more efficiently into the trap-pits. Fence constructions can be rather long, having an opening with a trap-pit here and there. An animal following along the side of the fence will drop into the pit when trying to go trough the opening.
translation: 陷坑常用于捕猎麋鹿和驯鹿等大型鹿类。挖坑需要一把铲子，挖好后可将坑遮盖起来，这是最简单的陷坑形式。也可以在坑底插上尖锐木桩，制成更完善、杀伤力更强的陷阱。使用陷坑时，人们通常会修筑围栏，将猎物更有效地引向陷坑。围栏可以很长，沿途每隔一段设置一个开口和陷坑。沿围栏行走的动物经过开口时，就会掉进坑里。

original:
Most of the clothing and armour names are self-explanatory.
Here's a list of some specific armours and their descriptions.
Metal armours are not usually worn nor made by the local cultures of The UnReal World, but they rely on fur and leather as armour materials.
Metal armours are brought in with foreign traders and warriors, but in general metal armours are very rare.

Head:
COWL, HELM, SPECTACLE HELM

Body:
HAUBERK, HABERGEON, CUIRASS, OVERCOAT

Legs:
KNEECOPS, SHIN GUARDS, LEGGINGS

Arms:
REREBRACES, COUDES, FOREARM GUARDS
translation:
大多数衣物和盔甲名称都很容易理解。
以下列出一些特殊盔甲及其说明。
虚幻世界的当地文化通常不穿戴或制作金属盔甲，而是以皮毛和皮革作为盔甲材料。
金属盔甲由外国商人和战士带来，但总体而言十分罕见。

头部：
COWL、HELM、SPECTACLE HELM

躯干：
HAUBERK、HABERGEON、CUIRASS、OVERCOAT

腿部：
KNEECOPS、SHIN GUARDS、LEGGINGS

手臂：
REREBRACES、COUDES、FOREARM GUARDS

original: The eagle owl is a very large owl. Their plumage is rusty brown with black markings, legs are covered with feathers, and their claws and beaks are black. They have large heads with striking ear tufts and fiercely glowing orange-coloured eyes. Eagle owls breed in scarce number in forests almost throughout UnReal World, except for the unforested mountainous areas of the extreme north. Their deep, hollow and far-reaching mating calls can be heard during winter nights. Eagle owls are birds of prey and hunt hares, small mammals and birds. They are active at night and very efficient hunters.
translation: 雕鸮是一种体型很大的猫头鹰。它们的羽毛呈锈棕色并带有黑色斑纹，腿上长着羽毛，爪子和喙都是黑色。它们头部宽大，有醒目的耳羽簇，眼睛呈炽亮的橙色。雕鸮数量稀少，几乎在虚幻世界各地的森林中繁殖，唯独极北部没有森林的山区除外。冬夜里，可以听到它们深沉、空洞而悠远的求偶叫声。雕鸮是猛禽，以野兔、小型哺乳动物和鸟类为食。它们夜间活动，是效率极高的猎手。

original:
A bow made from a single piece of wood, between four and six feet tall.
Longbows are not made recurved, but a slight natural recurve may sometimes occur depending on the material used. The limbs are relatively narrow and circular or D-shaped in the cross section. The bowstring is attached to the nock grooves carved at the at end of the limbs.
Generally the longbows are made as tall as the archer, and the design makes a fairly long draw possible. Of all the so-called self bows made from a single piece of wood, the longbow bears the greatest power and accuracy.
translation:
用一整块木料制成的弓，长度约为四至六英尺。
长弓不会制成反曲形，但根据所用材料，有时会自然形成轻微反曲。弓臂相对狭窄，横截面为圆形或 D 形。弓弦系在弓臂末端刻出的弦槽上。
长弓通常与弓手身高相仿，其设计允许较长的拉距。在所有由单块木料制成的所谓单体弓中，长弓的威力和精度最高。

original:
Among the eastern peoples and western peoples the basic unit of settlement is a single farm. It has a main building and some additional buildings like store-houses, animal-shed and sauna. A small farm is run by a family, usually including grand-parents and maybe some unmarried brothers or sisters. Bigger farms might have a couple of servants.

The northern peoples don't have farms, but camps of families. At some regularly used camp-sites they might build small buildings, like sauna and store-houses, but otherwise they use portable tents called kota.
translation:
东方和西方民族的基本居住单位是独户农庄。农庄有一座主屋，以及一些附属建筑，如仓房、畜棚和桑拿房。小农庄由一个家庭经营，通常包括祖父母，也可能有未婚的兄弟姐妹。较大的农庄可能雇有几名仆人。

北方民族没有农庄，而是以家庭为单位露营。他们可能会在定期使用的营地建造桑拿房和仓房等小型建筑；其他时候则住在名为 kota 的便携式帐篷里。

original:
Weapons can cause differing amounts of damage depending on the aspect selected and the target's armour, or thickness of animal's skin or fur.

There are three different weapon aspects - blunt, point and edge - and you get to choose the aspect to use upon executing an attack. Some weapons may have all three aspects, whereas others may only have one.

For example, you can use a sword to edge or point - or even blunt. Spears can be generally used for pointing and blunting with the shaft. Axes can be used to edge and blunt with the dull end.
translation:
武器造成的伤害会因所选攻击方式，以及目标的盔甲或动物皮肤、皮毛的厚度而有所不同。

武器有三种攻击方式：钝击、刺击和斩击；发动攻击时，你可以选择使用哪一种。有些武器三种方式都能使用，有些则只有其中一种。

例如，剑可以用于斩击、刺击，甚至钝击。长矛通常可以用于刺击，也可以用矛杆进行钝击。斧头可以用刃口斩击，也可以用钝头进行钝击。

original: A light lever trap ("loukku") is a trap for small animals suchs as hares and grouses. It consist of two part trigger stick mechanism which is holding up a slender tree trunk. Moving the trigger stick will release the trunk and drop it on the prey. Should the prey not die upon the impact it will at least get stuck under the weight of trunk, which is usually increased by placing a heavy stone on it. As the light lever trap is used to catch small non carnivorous animals baits aren't used, but the trap is placed on the known paths of the animals.
translation: 轻型杠杆陷阱（“loukku”）用来捕捉野兔和松鸡等小动物。陷阱由两部分构成的触发杆机构组成，用来撑起一根细树干。触碰触发杆后，树干便会落下砸向猎物。如果猎物没有当场被砸死，至少也会被压在树干下动弹不得；通常还会在树干上压一块重石来增加重量。轻型杠杆陷阱主要用于捕捉不食肉的小动物，因此不使用诱饵，而是设置在动物经常经过的路径上。

original: A laminated recurve bow made of two different types of wood, and covered with birch bark to protect it from the elements. The belly is made from special reaction wood of pine trees which gets developed when the tree grows aslant. The back and recurved ears are made of birch. The laminates are glued together with a glue made from perch skin. Different characteristics of the two wood types used gives the northern bow its outstanding performance and these bows are the finest and and fastest ones used among the peoples of the UnReal World.
translation: 由两种不同木材制成的层压反曲弓，外层覆有桦树皮以抵御风雨。弓腹使用松树中特殊的反应木制成，这种木材是在树木倾斜生长时形成的；弓背和反曲弓耳则由桦木制成。各层用鲈鱼皮制成的胶粘合。两种木材的不同特性赋予北方弓出众的性能；这种弓是虚幻世界各民族使用的弓中最精良、射速最快的。

original:
A missile combat weapon which consists chiefly of a powerful shortbow mounted horizontally on a wooden stock which has a trigger device to cock and release an arrow. Compared to regular bows they are easier to shoot accurately even for the unskilled as releasing an arrow by pulling the trigger is always quite steady. Unlike other bows they may also be carried loaded and ready to be fired instantly, but this advantage is offset by their longer time to reload.
Crossbows are mostly of foreign origin and rarely used by local cultures.
translation:
一种投射武器，主体是强力短弓，横向安装在木制弩身上，并配有用于张弦和释放箭矢的扳机装置。与普通弓相比，即使不熟练的人也更容易用弩准确射击，因为扣动扳机释放箭矢时总能保持相当稳定。弩还可以预先上弦、随身携带并随时发射，但重新装填需要更长时间，抵消了这一优势。
弩大多来自外国，当地文化很少使用。

original: Nalbinding is a technique for making clothes from wool yarn using a needle to form and connect stitches in a specific sequence, creating a continuous textile. The yarn is used in lengths of a few metres, with the needle held in one hand and the thumb of the other hand used to regulate the size of the stitches. The method is time-consuming, but creates elastic and warm clothes. It is most commonly used to produce rather small but important wintertime garments such as nalbound socks, cowls and mittens.
translation: 针毡编结（nalbinding）是一种用针按特定顺序穿引羊毛纱线、形成并连接针脚，从而织成连续织物的技法。纱线每段长几米，一只手持针，另一只手的拇指用来控制针脚大小。这种方法很费时间，但织成的衣物富有弹性且保暖。它最常用于制作较小但重要的冬季衣物，如针毡编结袜、兜帽和连指手套。

original:
A cloak is considered an essential part of both women's and men's everyday clothing, whether in the village or out in the wilderness, especially in colder weather. In winter, a fur cloak can be a practical choice, but otherwise cloaks are typically made from a large rectangular piece of cloth with the edges sewn to prevent fraying.
Cloaks can be worn in many ways and fastened with a brooch or by tying them. Women's cloaks sometimes feature a variety of decorations and long fringes.
translation:
斗篷是男女日常穿着的必备衣物，无论在村庄还是荒野皆然，天气寒冷时尤其如此。冬季穿毛皮斗篷很实用；除此之外，斗篷通常由一大块长方形布料制成，并将边缘缝好以防散开。
斗篷有多种穿法，可以用胸针固定，也可以系起来。女性斗篷有时会带有各种装饰和长流苏。

original: Big deadfall trap is mainly targeted for wolves, but it works also for foxes, gluttons and the like. It's made by setting several slender tree trunks in a relatively wide roof construction and placing heavy stones on top of the trunks. One trunk is used to lift the deadfall roof up and a stick, with a bait tied to it, is then set on a round stone as a triggering mechanism. As the stick is carefully placed on the stone even a very light pulling of the bait will drop the deadfall roof down.
translation: 大型压砸陷阱主要用来捕狼，也能捕捉狐狸、狼獾等动物。制作时，将几根细长树干架成较宽的顶棚结构，并在上面放置重石。用一根树干撑起陷阱顶棚，再把系有诱饵的木棍放在圆石上作为触发装置。木棍在石头上放置得恰到好处，哪怕轻轻拉动诱饵，也会使顶棚落下。

original: Lamellar is eastern armour type used by Njerpezit. Lamellar armours are made of square or rectangular iron plates tightly fastened to each other with leather straps passed through openings along the edges of the plates. Lamellar technique is used mainly to create cuirass and hauberk type armors, but it's also suitable for some spot protection pieces like shin guards and forearm guards. Lamellar armour offers better protection than mail, especially in case of blunt attacks.
translation: 札甲是一种东方盔甲，Njerpezit 会使用。札甲由方形或长方形铁片制成，皮带穿过铁片边缘的孔洞，将铁片紧密连接在一起。札甲技法主要用于制作胸甲和锁子外衣，也适合制作护胫、护臂等局部护具。札甲的防护能力优于锁子甲，尤其能抵挡钝击。

original: Separate pieces of clothing to protect legs; actually the hips, groin, thighs, knees and calves. Leggings can be made from cloth, leather, or fur, depending on the level of protection desired. They are tied on with leather thongs or cords. When worn with pair of trousers leggings give extra protection and warmth. Sometimes leggings are also worn instead of trousers, as they are much easier to make than trousers, which require a great deal of cutting and sewing.
translation: 用于保护腿部的独立衣物，实际覆盖臀部、腹股沟、大腿、膝盖和小腿。护腿可用布料、皮革或毛皮制作，具体取决于所需的防护程度。它们用皮带或绳带系牢。与裤子一起穿时，护腿能额外提供防护和保暖。有时人们也会用护腿代替裤子，因为护腿比需要大量裁剪和缝制的裤子容易制作得多。

original:
Shirts can be either short or long-sleeved, and the length of the hem also varies. Cloth shirts are always short-sleeved, except for the undershirt, which is long-sleeved and has a longer hem. A cloth shirt is sometimes also worn over other outer long-sleeved layers of clothing, such as a tunic.
Shirts made of leather and fur are always long-sleeved. A leather shirt is worn instead of a cloth shirt when additional protection is needed.
translation:
衬衫有短袖和长袖之分，衣摆长短也不相同。布衬衫通常都是短袖，只有内衫是长袖且衣摆更长。有时也会在其他长袖外衣（如束腰 tunic）外面穿一件布衬衫。
皮衬衫和毛皮衬衫则都是长袖。需要额外防护时，可以用皮衬衫代替布衬衫。

original: An arrow with the widest cutting head of all arrow types. They usually have two blades which are sharpened very carefully. Broadheads are designed to cause large cuts and inflict as much bleeding as possible. These arrows are effectively used to hunt large game. Even if the hunter wouldn't score immediately fatal hits the bleeding wounds that broadhead arrows can cause are often enough to kill the prey sooner or later.
translation: 所有箭种中，宽刃箭的箭头最宽。它们通常有两个经过精细打磨的刃口。宽刃箭的设计旨在造成大面积割伤，尽可能引发流血。它们非常适合猎捕大型猎物。即使猎人没有立刻造成致命伤，宽刃箭造成的流血伤口往往也足以让猎物迟早丧命。

original: A cowl is a piece of clothing that covers the head and neck, used mainly for warmth and protection from the elements. A woollen nalbound cowl is a typical wintertime garment worn by local cultures, but it can be also sewn from cloth if only a thin and light cover is desired. Foreign warriors may also wear mail armour cowls for protection in battle. Sometimes they are made long enough to cover also the shoulders.
translation: 兜帽是一种覆盖头部和颈部的衣物，主要用于保暖和抵御恶劣天气。羊毛针毡编结兜帽是当地民族典型的冬季衣物，但若只需要轻薄的遮护，也可以用布料缝制。外国战士有时会戴锁子甲兜帽，以便战斗时防护。有些兜帽做得足够长，还能遮住肩膀。

original:
An item believed to bring good luck to its owner. Typically the hare's paw is applied and stroked prior to forthcoming attempt where extra luck or success is desired. It's said that charm of hare's paw will wear out over time and therefore it should be applied with care.
Not just any paw from a hare is useful as a charm, but it needs to be found in certain conditions which aren't common knowlegde.
translation:
一种被认为能给持有者带来好运的物品。人们通常会在即将尝试需要额外好运或成功的事情之前使用并抚摸野兔脚。相传野兔脚的护身功效会随时间减弱，因此应谨慎使用。
并非野兔的任何一只脚都能当作护身符；只有在某些不为人熟知的条件下找到的野兔脚才有此效。

original:
These colors indicate the state of your injuries. The state of fresh wounds is not known until they have been treated - or have started to heal on their own.
BL abbreviation is used for bleeding wounds.

The TREATED bar shows how many of all the possible treatments have been applied to the wound today. Wounds can be treated on a daily basis by using the PHYSICIAN skill.
translation:
这些颜色表示伤势的状态。新鲜伤口在得到处理或开始自行愈合之前，无法判断其状况。
BL 是流血伤口的缩写。

TREATED（已处理）栏显示今天对伤口进行了多少种可能的处理。可以每天使用 PHYSICIAN（医术）技能治疗伤口。

original: Ravens are large, completely black birds with strongly built beaks. Ravens prefer extensive areas of forest and exist throughout UnReal World in rather scarce number. They are sensitive and cautious, but also inquisitive. Ravens are mainly scavengers feeding on carcasses of dead animals, but their diet may also vary widely and ravens can be considered quite omnivorous.
translation: 乌鸦是体型较大的全黑色鸟类，喙结实有力。它们偏爱广阔的森林地区，在整个虚幻世界都有分布，但数量相当稀少。乌鸦警觉谨慎，同时也充满好奇。它们主要以死去动物的尸体为食，但食性也十分广泛，可以视为杂食动物。

original:
Most of the names are left untranslated. Words such as "Kaumo" or "Kiesse" are so old, that no one knows their original meaning, and thus translation is impossible. "Kaumo" just means a certain region of The Unreal World.
Some words could be translated, but are left as such for the sake of the spirit.

See language inflexions table for further information.
translation:
大多数名称都不翻译。有些词，比如“Kaumo”或“Kiesse”，年代极其久远，原意无人知晓，因此无法翻译。“Kaumo”只是虚幻世界某个地区的名称。
有些词虽然可以翻译，但为了保留韵味而不作翻译。

更多信息请参见语言变格表。

original: An apron is part of a woman's everyday attire, and its purpose is to protect other garments while working. Decorated aprons are also worn on important special occasions. It's made from a rectangular piece of cloth with the edges sewn to prevent fraying. The apron is fastened around the waist with a cord threaded through it and usually extends down to the knees.
translation: 围裙是女性日常服饰的一部分，用来在工作时保护其他衣物。装饰精美的围裙也会在重要的特殊场合穿着。它由一块长方形布料制成，边缘缝合以防散开。围裙上穿有系带，系在腰间，通常垂至膝盖。

original:
Bow is a missile combat weapon usually made of wood and used to propel an arrow. There are different bow types and designs varying in size, shape and strength:
SPRUCE QUICK-BOW, SHORTBOW, LONGBOW, NORTHERN BOW and HUNTING BOW.

In addition to these regular bows there are also crossbows which are mostly of foreign origin.
See also: BOWSTRING
translation:
弓是一种投射武器，通常由木头制成，用来发射箭矢。弓有不同的类型和设计，在尺寸、形状和强度上各不相同：
SPRUCE QUICK-BOW、SHORTBOW、LONGBOW、NORTHERN BOW 和 HUNTING BOW。

除了这些常见弓种，还有主要来自外国的弩。
另见：BOWSTRING

original:
The common arrowhead is made of iron and has a spearhead shaped tip. They cause small but deep puncture wounds and have the best piercing capabilities of all arrow types.

Arowheads can be also made of bone or stone, but these are inferior materials compared to the iron and their usage is usually restricted only to survival situations.
translation:
常见箭头由铁制成，箭尖呈矛头形。它们造成较小但较深的穿刺伤，在所有箭种中穿透力最强。

箭头也可以用骨头或石头制成，但这些材料不如铁，通常只在求生时使用。

context: resource:GAME.NFO:CAP.BIRCH-BARK CAP.BIRCH-BARK CAPS.LEATHER CAP.FUR CAP.WOOLLEN NALBOUND CAP
original: A cap is a headwear that comes in various shapes and is designed to cover the head. It can be made from a variety of materials depending on its intended use. In winter, it is common to wear a fur cap or a woollen nalbound cap for warmth. A leather cap or birch-bark cap may be worn in less demanding weather when head coverage is desired.
translation: 帽子是一种形状各异、用于遮盖头部的头饰，可根据用途采用多种材料制作。冬季常戴毛皮帽或羊毛针毡编结帽保暖。天气不太恶劣时，若需要遮住头部，则可以戴皮帽或桦树皮帽。
aliases: .CAP.BIRCH-BARK CAP.BIRCH-BARK CAPS.LEATHER CAP.FUR CAP.WOOLLEN NALBOUND CAP.

original: A group of single farms is called a village. Northern tribes don't have proper villages at all. Kaumolaiset and Islanders also tend to live in rather isolated single farms. In the Driik one might find villages which are dense groups of four to five farms interconnected with roads. The rest of the cultures have somewhat looser villages.
translation: 若干独户农庄聚集在一起，就称为村庄。北方部族根本没有真正的村庄。Kaumolaiset 和岛民也往往住在彼此隔离的独户农庄中。在 Driik，可能会看到由四五个农庄密集组成、并由道路相连的村庄。其他文化的村庄则相对分散。

original: Palm-sized comb with the back of the handle crafted into a shape of two horse heads facing to opposite directions. Different variants of the comb are manufactured in Reemi. Similar type of comb is also imported by foreign traders. The comb is not for common day-to-day use, but carried as a decorative item on special occasions.
translation: 一种手掌大小的梳子，梳背雕成两颗朝相反方向的马头。Reemi 会制作这种梳子的不同样式。外国商人也会进口类似的梳子。它不是日常用品，而是在特殊场合随身携带的装饰品。

original: The weight of the hare is typically about 3 kg but can be even 5 kg. Hares live mainly in the forests all around the Unreal World. It is actively seeking food in the twilight and in the night-time. In the day time it sleeps in any simple natural shelter. The hare fur is snowwhite in the winter and sandbrown in the summer.
translation: 野兔体重通常约 3 千克，最大可达 5 千克。野兔生活在虚幻世界各地的森林中。它们会在黄昏和夜间积极觅食，白天则在简易天然掩蔽处休息。冬季野兔毛皮雪白，夏季则呈沙棕色。

original: Broad beans grow strong and provide nutritious food. After harvesting the beans are dried. Harvested beans will automatically begin to dry, but fresh ones can be used also. Dried beans will last for years, although they require quite a long cooking time. A commonly used cookery recipe for broad beans is the bean stew.
translation: 蚕豆长势旺盛，能提供营养丰富的食物。收获后应将豆子晒干。收获的蚕豆会自动开始干燥，但也可以食用新鲜蚕豆。干豆能保存数年，不过烹煮需要很长时间。蚕豆常见的烹饪方式是做成豆子炖菜。

original:
You start with these spells and magic means to interact and communicate with the spirits and the otherworld. You'll learn more during your life.
Exit this screen when you are ready to continue character creation or take a moment to learn more by bringing the selector over the desired spell to view its description.
translation:
你初始就掌握这些法术和魔法手段，可以用来与精灵和异界互动、交流。今后的人生中你还会学到更多。
准备好继续创建角色时，请退出此界面；也可以将选择器移到感兴趣的法术上查看说明，花些时间进一步了解。

original:
The most common birds of the UnReal World are descriped here:

Forest game birds:
BLACK GROUSE, WILLOW GROUSE, HAZEL GROUSE, CAPERCAILLIE

Aquatic birds:
KUIKKA, GOLDENEYE, SWAN, TUFTED DUCK, MALLARD

Birds of prey:
GOSHAWK, EAGLE OWL

The rest:
RAVEN
translation:
这里介绍虚幻世界中最常见的鸟类：

森林猎鸟：
BLACK GROUSE、WILLOW GROUSE、HAZEL GROUSE、CAPERCAILLIE

水鸟：
KUIKKA、GOLDENEYE、SWAN、TUFTED DUCK、MALLARD

猛禽：
GOSHAWK、EAGLE OWL

其他：
RAVEN

original:
A crossbow with a heavier bow strengthened by bone or metal. Heavy crossbows are more powerful than any regular bow but their long reloading time rarely allows a second shot if the target is approaching or escaping fast enough.
Crossbows are mostly of foreign origin and rarely used by local cultures.
translation:
弩的弓臂更重，并以骨头或金属加固。重弩比任何普通弓都更有威力，但装填时间很长；如果目标接近或逃跑得够快，通常来不及再射第二箭。
弩大多来自外国，当地文化很少使用。

original: A relief figure of a bear head and forepaws, cast in bronze. This type of pendant is imported by the foreign traders. The pendant often comes without a chain, so it is often attached to a simple leather cord. It is worn on rituals, celebrations and other special occasions by men of eastern cultures.
translation: 一件浮雕饰品，塑造了熊头和前爪的形象，以青铜铸造。这种吊坠由外国商人进口。它常常不附链子，因此人们通常将其系在一根简单的皮绳上。东方文化的男性会在仪式、庆典和其他特殊场合佩戴。

original: Principle of a deadfall trap is to have a varying weight deadfall to drop on the prey then the trap is triggered. Deadfall traps vary in size and in weight of the deadfall depending on what animal they are designed for. See: SMALL DEADFALL TRAP, BIG DEADFALL TRAP and HEAVY DEADFALL BEAR TRAP.
translation: 压砸陷阱的原理是触发后让不同重量的重物落到猎物身上。陷阱的尺寸和重物重量各不相同，取决于目标动物。参见：SMALL DEADFALL TRAP、BIG DEADFALL TRAP 和 HEAVY DEADFALL BEAR TRAP。

original: Three finely crafted thin silver chains braided to form a single bracelet. This kind of valuables are crafted overseas, and sold by foreign traders. Both the amount of silver and the decorative quality make this bracelet a highly valued item. Wearing one is a sign of wealth and status.
translation: 三条精工打造的细银链编织成一只手镯。这类贵重物品产自海外，由外国商人出售。手镯含银量高、装饰精美，因此价值不菲。佩戴它象征着财富和地位。

original: A hollow bronze ball, usually a little less than an inch in diameter. The ball is decorated with embossed pebbles, forming lines round the ball. The ball hangs from a thin bronze chain. This type of pendant is sold by the foreign traders and worn by women of western cultures.
translation: 一颗中空的青铜球，直径通常略小于一英寸。球面饰有凸起的小圆点，围绕球体排成一圈圈纹路。球体悬挂在一条细青铜链上。这种吊坠由外国商人出售，西方文化的女性会佩戴。

original: A long coat which extends to the knee and has long sleeves to cover the whole arms. Overcoats are made of wool cloth or fur and most commonly used in winter when warmth is more important. They are made loose enough to allow several layers of clothing to be worn underneath.
translation: 一种长至膝盖、带有长袖且能遮住整条手臂的外套。长外套由羊毛布料或毛皮制成，最常在保暖更重要的冬季穿着。它们剪裁宽松，可在里面穿好几层衣物。

original: A fur hood is a warm and protective covering for the whole head. It is made loose enough to cover the wearer's face as well, which is essential in cold and windy weather. Fur offers protection from many types of impact, so it can also be used as light head armour.
translation: 毛皮兜帽能温暖并保护整个头部。它的尺寸足够宽松，也能遮住佩戴者的脸；在寒冷多风的天气里，这点至关重要。毛皮能抵御多种冲击，因此也可以用作轻型头部护甲。

original:
Basically a reinforced club. Most have metal heads, oftern with an elaborate pattern of knobs and ridges, affixed to wooden shafts between 24 and 38 inches in length. Some maces have metal shafts.
Maces are of foreign origin and not known by local cultures.
translation:
本质上是一种加固的棍棒。大多数狼牙棒的头部由金属制成，常带有精巧的凸点和棱脊，固定在长 24 至 38 英寸的木柄上。有些狼牙棒使用金属柄。
狼牙棒来自外国，当地文化并不熟悉。

original:
Axe head is the cutting part of an axe attached to the axe haft. The head of an axe has two ends - the blade on one side, and the butt on the other. There are many different types of axe heads for different types of axes.
See WEAPONS for more information.
translation:
斧头的斧刃部分安装在斧柄上。斧头有两端：一侧是刃口，另一侧是斧背。不同类型的斧子有许多不同的斧头样式。
更多信息请参见 WEAPONS。

original: A coat made of mail or lamellar. Hauberks cover the shoulders, thorax, abdomen, hips groin and thighs. Long hauberk is lengthened to cover the knees and also has short sleeves to protect the upper arms. The skirt is usually split to facilitate mounted use.
translation: 一种由锁子甲或札甲制成的外衣，覆盖肩膀、胸部、腹部、臀部、腹股沟和大腿。长款锁子外衣加长至膝盖，并带有短袖以保护上臂。下摆通常开衩，方便骑乘。

original: There's more information available about highlighted topics. To display a page, choose and select the topic by using the cursor keys and ENTER - or by clicking with the mouse. You can also type a free keyword/topic to search for a specific page.
translation: 高亮主题还有更多相关信息。若要查看页面，请使用光标键移动到主题并按 ENTER 选择，也可以用鼠标点击。你还可以输入自由关键词或主题，搜索特定页面。

original: Armour which forms a rigid continuous covering and is made of iron. Iron armours are relatively rare. Its use is generally restricted helms, and small plates for spot protection. Iron armours offer good to excellent defense against all strikes.
translation: 由铁制成、形成坚硬连续覆盖层的盔甲。铁甲相当罕见，通常只用于头盔和小型局部护甲。铁甲对各种打击都能提供良好至极佳的防护。

original: A ring with a wide bezel decorated with a relief figure. Common figures are an eagle, a bear head, and an aquatic bird. Imported by foreign traders, this type of ring is favored by the wealthy men among eastern and northern tribes.
translation: 一种带有宽阔戒面、并饰以浮雕图案的戒指。常见图案包括鹰、熊头和水鸟。这种戒指由外国商人进口，东方和北方部族中的富裕男性尤其喜爱。

original: A ring made of silver with a decoration composed of dots and curly lines running all around the outer side of the ring. This type of rings are sold and imported by foreign traders, but also produced by skilled craftsmen of Driik.
translation: 一枚银戒，外侧环绕饰有点状和卷曲线条组成的图案。这种戒指由外国商人进口并出售，Driik 的熟练工匠也会制作。

original: Any double or single edged, straight-bladed, sword averaging 24 inches in length. The point of a shortsword is usually no sharper than the edge, but it may be designed to have a real point at the option of its maker.
translation: 一种单刃或双刃直刃剑，长度平均约 24 英寸。短剑的尖端通常不像刃口那样锋利，不过制作者也可以选择将其设计成真正的尖头。

original: Short nalbound woollen socks that reach up to the ankles, designed to protect the wearer's feet especially during the wintertime. When more complete leg coverage is desired, there are also nalbound knee socks.
translation: 短款羊毛针毡编结袜，只到脚踝，用于保护穿着者的双脚，尤其适合冬季穿着。若需要更完整地覆盖腿部，也有针毡编结及膝袜。

original: The blade of a shovel is the lowermost part of the tool, which makes contact with the ground. Shovel blades are made of iron, and need to be hafted with a wooden handle in order to assemble a working shovel.
translation: 铲子的铲叶是工具最下端、与地面接触的部分。铲叶由铁制成，必须装上木柄才能组装成可用的铲子。

original: General swimming. Swimming is possible on the zoomed in local map. Use this skill while facing the water to move forward. If you have a low swimming skill you could be in danger of drowning.
translation: 一般游泳。只能在放大的本地地图上游泳。面朝水面时使用这项技能即可向前游。如果游泳技能较低，可能会有溺水危险。

original: An ordinary knife with a blade of about three inches long. The small knife is mainly designed for making fine woodworks. It is also commonly used when cutting ropes, removing birch-bark etc.
translation: 一种普通小刀，刀刃长约 三英寸。小刀主要用于精细木工，也常用于割绳子、剥取桦树皮等工作。

original: Netting needle is a wooden tool used to make nets. It is quite simple but essential tool that allows weaving the net with proper knots and forming a tightly fastened mesh of uniform size.
translation: 网针是一种用于制作渔网的木制工具。它结构简单，却不可或缺，能用合适的结法编织渔网，并织出大小均匀、紧密牢固的网眼。

original: The pine-marten's length is about 50 cm and weight about 1 kg. It is very fast and able to climb trees. It is usually active in the night and in the twilight. It is hunted for its fur.
translation: 松貂体长约 50 厘米，体重约 1 千克。它行动迅速，善于爬树。通常在夜间和黄昏活动，人们捕猎它是为了获取皮毛。

context: resource:GAME.NFO:SEWING NEEDLE.IRON SEWING NEEDLE.BONE SEWING NEEDLE.NEEDLE
original: Sewing needle is a fundamental tool for making and repairing clothes. The most handy sewing needles are made of iron by blacksmiths, but they can be also crafted from animal bone.
translation: 缝衣针是制作和修补衣物的基本工具。最实用的缝衣针由铁匠用铁制成，也可以用动物骨头制作。

original: A glove without separate fingers to protect and warm the wearer's hands. Mittens are an essential wintertime garment and are commonly made of fur or wool yarn by nalbinding.
translation: 一种没有分指、用于保护并温暖双手的手套。连指手套是冬季必备衣物，通常用毛皮制作，或以羊毛纱线通过针毡编结制成。

original: A two-handed club/mace with a 4-6 foot shaft. Most have wooden heads, sometimes reinforced with metal studs. Mauls are of foreign origin and not known by local cultures.
translation: 一种双手使用的棍棒或狼牙棒，柄长 4 至 6 英尺。大多数有木制头部，有时会用金属钉加固。长柄重棒来自外国，当地文化并不熟悉。

original: Netmaking is a skill for weaving and constructing fishing nets, and crafting a lippo. Success in netmaking determines the quality of the nets or the lippo crafted.
translation: 织网技能用于编织和制作渔网，也用于制作 lippo。织网是否成功，决定了所制渔网或 lippo 的品质。

original:
A spindle is a tool made from wood used for spinning plant fibres into yarn.
All the fibre processing is carried out by using your TEXTILECRAFT skill.
translation:
纺锤是一种木制工具，用于将植物纤维纺成纱线。
所有纤维加工都要使用 TEXTILECRAFT 技能。

original: The boar a is very uncommon species living in the south-eastern part of The Unreal World. Boar's weight is about 125 kg. Males have small but sharp fangs.
translation: 野猪是一种非常罕见的动物，生活在虚幻世界的东南部。野猪体重约 125 千克。雄性长有短小但锋利的獠牙。

original: A thightly curved blade on a short (usually wooden) shaft. Most sickles are farm implements, but in some regions they are used as secondary weapons.
translation: 一种装在短柄（通常为木柄）上的弯曲镰刀形刀刃。大多数镰刀是农具，但在某些地区也会作为副武器使用。

original: A light spear balanced to be thrown as a missile weapon. They can be used in melee combat, but their light and thin shafts make them more fragile.
translation: 一种轻型长矛，经过平衡设计，可作为投射武器投掷。它也能用于近战，但其轻而细的矛杆更容易损坏。

original: Unarmed fighting (kicking,punching etc.). This is an automatic skill and it's activated everytime you execute unarmed combat maneuver.
translation: 徒手格斗（踢、打拳等）。这是一项自动技能，每次执行徒手战斗动作时都会启用。

original: A tendon is a fibrous connective tissue that attaches muscle to bone. Tendons of butchered animals are used in making of sinew yarn.
translation: 肌腱是一种纤维结缔组织，用于连接肌肉和骨骼。屠宰动物后取下的肌腱可用于制作筋线。

original: An axe with longish, thin blade. Ideal for shaping logs so that they would fit each other in the walls and corners of a building.
translation: 一种斧刃较长而薄的斧子，适合修整原木，使其能够彼此嵌合，搭建建筑的墙壁和墙角。

original: A crude but effective weapon which can be used to cut down trees - although any timberwork with a stone-axe requires patience.
translation: 一种粗糙但有效的武器，可以用来砍树；不过用石斧做任何木工活都需要耐心。

original: A narrow flat piece of wood split from a board. Slats are used for example as a raw material for making arrow shafts.
translation: 从木板上劈下的一块狭长扁平木片。例如，木条可作为制作箭杆的原材料。

original: A bull elk. This in-game term was in use until version 3.40 and was then removed. Now stags are called bull elks.
translation: 雄性麋鹿。游戏中一直使用这个术语，直到 3.40 版将其移除。现在 stag（雄麋鹿）称为 bull elk。

original: Invocations and rituals marked with this color work differently and are automatically performed upon selection.
translation: 以此颜色标记的祈祷和仪式，施行方式有所不同，选中后会自动施行。

original: "Tietäjä" means literally "the one who knows the road", e.g. the sage, the sorcerer or the wise man.
translation: “Tietäjä”字面意思是“知晓道路之人”，例如贤者、巫师或智者。

original: Bandages are strips or slices of cloth, leather etc. used to tie up wounds with the PHYSICIAN skill.
translation: 绷带是用布料、皮革等裁成的条带或布片，使用 PHYSICIAN 技能包扎伤口。

original: Slender tree trunks are trunks of young trees. Use your timbercraft skill to fell down trees.
translation: 细树干是幼树的树干。使用 timbercraft 技能伐倒树木。

original:
Refer to counterstrike, dodge, block.

This topic is under construction.
translation:
参见 counterstrike、dodge、block。

本条目仍在编写中。

original: The all-round tool used when eating, making handcrafts, fighting and so on.
translation: 一种用途广泛的工具，可用于进食、制作手工艺品、战斗等。

original: Armour for the knee, usually iron, generally secured by leather thongs.
translation: 用于保护膝盖的护甲，通常由铁制成，一般用皮带固定。

original: Armour for the forearms. They can be made of lamellar or leather.
translation: 用于保护前臂的护甲，可由札甲片或皮革制成。

original: Some of these items are descriped here: SALT, POT.
translation: 这里介绍了其中一些物品：SALT、POT。

original: Simple loop of yarn set to catch mainly hares.
translation: 一种简单的绳套，用来捕捉野兔等动物。

original: Paddle is used to shove punt or raft ahead.
translation: 用来推动平底船或木筏前进的桨。
